market_summary: All assets are currently consolidating or reaching key structural extremes during London session. US100 and BTCUSD remain structurally bullish above VWAP/EMA50 but are trading near session high resistance without immediate momentum triggers. EURUSD and GBPUSD are in strong downtrends testing session lows and lower ATR bands where sell-side risk/reward is unfavorable. Gold remains compressed inside its session value area.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.14 to VAH 4060.33) and trading above POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-0.36). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (4048.78) and EMA50 (4051.19), finding support near the S/R level at 4052.38 in the middle of the ATR channel with normal volume (no recent RVOL spike). Lacks explosive breakout confirmation to trade toward Session High 4066.79.

Price is below VAL 1.11430 and POC 1.11658, trading below VWAP 1.11527 and EMA50 1.11553. CVD is NEUTRAL (-2,024). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hugging the lower -2 ATR band (1.11352) near Session Low 1.11314. While the trend is strongly bearish, price is stretched at the lower band without an active RVOL > 2.0 breakout candle right now, making entry risky before a consolidation or pullback.

Price trades below VAL 1.33223 and POC 1.33468, well under VWAP 1.33337 and EMA50 1.33372. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,317). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is touching the lower ATR band (1.33137) and testing Session Low 1.33140 for the 4th time. Volume is moderate without an RVOL spike. Testing a major support floor while extended at lower ATR band warrants caution.

Price is inside VA near VAH 28261.60 and well above POC 28114.25. CVD is BULLISH (+9.03 with positive slope 1.27). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is strongly bullish above ascending VWAP 28081.90 and EMA50 28073.75. Price is pressing upper ATR band 28267.12 and testing Session High 28261.60. (US100 tick volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0). However, entering right into Session High and upper ATR limit offers poor immediate risk/reward before a minor pullback.
signals.level_event: acceptance near VAH 28261.60 and Session High

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH 73808.59 and POC 73660.40, holding above VWAP 73650.72 and EMA50 73705.04. CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.03) showing delta divergence against the price rise.
